concerns.text: Task T017 (Implement code/main.py) is scheduled before T018 (Implement fallback logic for near-zero scores). The main entry point (T017) must route to heuristics and handle the 'empty selection' edge case defined in T018. If T017 is implemented without T018, the system will crash or behave nondeterministically when scores are near-zero, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' flow for the selection logic.

Task T023 (Integrate heuristic execution with metric calculation) depends on the baseline metrics generated by T022c (Implement code/eval/baseline_runner.py). While T022c is listed before T023, T023 also implicitly depends on T024 (result aggregation) to format the output correctly for the report. The current order suggests T023 runs before T024, which may result in T023 attempting to write incomplete or unaggregated data to the report structure.

Task T030 (Integrate statistical tests) is scheduled before T031 (Generate final report) and T032b (Ensure false_positive_rate is written). T030 requires the 'false_positive_rate' metric to be available to include in the statistical comparison or report generation. Since T032b (calculating and writing this specific metric) is listed after T030, T030 cannot fulfill its requirement to 'prioritize Paired t-test p-values in the report' if the necessary data (false_positive_rate) is not yet computed or written by T032b.

Task T044 (Implement streaming_chunker.py) depends on T043 (Refactor loader.py to remove synthetic fallbacks). The streaming chunker (T044) consumes data from the loader. If T044 is implemented before T043, the chunker might inadvertently process synthetic data if the loader still contains fallback logic, violating the 'Data Hygiene' flow. T043 must strictly precede T044 to ensure the data stream is clean before chunking logic is applied.

Task T037 (Loader verification logic) is marked as [US1] but placed in Phase 2 (Foundational). While the comment notes it was moved to ensure data integrity, the [US1] tag implies it belongs to the User Story 1 block. For strict 'User-story groups' independence, T037 should either be moved into Phase 3 (US1) or the tag should be removed to reflect its foundational status, as it blocks all stories, not just US1.
